## `/fundadmin:fund vault-init [path]` {#vault-init}

Create Obsidian vault with dashboards, templates & Dataview queries

Creates an Obsidian vault for fund administration: review subfolders, Dataview dashboards, Fund and Investor templates, and an Inbox ready for `/fundadmin:fund ingest`. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund vault-init` or asks to set up a fund vault or knowledge base.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund vault-init [path]` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-vault-init [path]` |
| Codex | `$fund-vault-init [path]` |

[Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-vault-init/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund vault-sync [path]` {#vault-sync}

Sync reviews into vault with frontmatter, tags & backlinks

Copies approved new reviews into the Obsidian vault with YAML frontmatter, tags and backlinks; proposes additions to existing Fund and Investor notes without overwriting them. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund vault-sync` or asks to sync reviews into the vault.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund vault-sync [path]` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-vault-sync [path]` |
| Codex | `$fund-vault-sync [path]` |

**Writes** `VAULT-SYNC-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-vault-sync/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund monitor-email [--days N]` {#monitor-email}

Monitor Gmail for GP emails with PDF attachments, download to vault Inbox

Reads an explicitly authorised Gmail scope for fund emails, stages PDF attachments in an isolated review run and logs provenance. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund monitor-email` or asks to check for new GP documents.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund monitor-email [--days N]` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-monitor-email [--days N]` |
| Codex | `$fund-monitor-email [--days N]` |

**Writes** `EMAIL-MONITOR-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-monitor-email/SKILL.md)
